title: The converter bypassed (the ESCs on the 20.5 V pack) without a ball: the pre-feed check, and the trip with a 1.3-1.6 ms pair

checks.check: (a) within 100 ms of the first eRPM read above the limit

notes: The eRPM never reaches the 20.5 V no-load (~28,500 rpm): the ramp passes the limit (16,650 rpm) about half a second in and the turret is SAFE three telemetry reads later.
